bugs.title: Enhancement pass's 2x-upscale scaffold stretches the frame AND makes sharpening measurably worse — remove it entirely, sharpen at native resolution
bugs.notes: Seeded from sweep prompt. Root cause to re-verify empirically: UPSCALE='scale=w=min(2160,2*iw):h=min(3840,2*ih):flags=lanczos' has per-axis caps so 1920x1080 -> 2160x2160 (non-uniform scale), then RESCALE_BACK divides both axes by a flat /2 -> 1080x1080 (wrong aspect) before reframe. Also, the final lanczos downscale low-pass-blurs away most of the sharpening gain (prior measurement: native cas+unsharp ~2923 Laplacian variance vs ~865 through the scaffold round trip). Fix: remove UPSCALE/RESCALE_BACK, keep cas/unsharp at native res, keep setsar=1, document bug-60 rationale alongside bug-11/bug-25 history, add regression test asserting no 2*iw/2*ih in FILTER_CHAIN. | in_progress: starting empirical re-verification of aspect-ratio bug and sharpening loss. | DONE: re-verified empirically pre-fix — old chain output 1080x1080 from 1920x1080 input (aspect stretch CONFIRMED on current main), new chain 1920x1080 SAR 1:1. Removed UPSCALE+RESCALE_BACK from FILTER_CHAIN and the filtergraph in enhance_one; _level_and_vbv simplified (no more 2x sizing assumption, Level 5.1 only for already-large inputs); docstring + bug-11/bug-25 comments updated with bug-60 rationale, history preserved; setsar=1 confirmed at chain end. Regression tests in pipeline/tests/test_enhance_chain.py: 5/5 pass (no 2*iw/2*ih/scale in chain, stage order, mobile-safe constants). Note on sharpness metric: my synthetic grid frame is high-contrast so lapvar magnitudes (~2500-3500) arent comparable to the prompts ~441/~865/~2923 low-contrast frame; scaffold-vs-native sharpness deltas will be measured properly in bug-61 tuning. Confidence: high — aspect fix verified by ffprobe, chain verified by tests + successful ffmpeg render.

bugs.title: Retune the sharpening chain for a noticeably crisper pop now that the scaffold is gone — verify empirically on real content, do not guess parameter values
bugs.notes: Seeded from sweep prompt. Depends on bug-60. Starting estimate from synthetic frame: cas=strength=0.9 + unsharp=7:7:1.0:5:5:0.35 measured ~5.4x sharper than old scaffolded chain. Must bracket cas 0.75/0.85/0.9/0.95 and unsharp luma 0.85/0.95/1.0/1.1 on REAL anime-style footage, inspect for ringing/halos on line art and amplified noise in flat fills; pick strongest artifact-free setting; evaluate hqdn3d 0.8:0.6:3.0:2.0 adequacy (change only if needed); evaluate smartblur-based clarity pass (include only if measurably better). Do NOT touch eq/LUT color. Record all tried/rejected values in notes. | in_progress: bug-60 done and confirmed on origin/main; starting empirical retune. | DONE: final values cas=strength=0.9 + unsharp=7:7:1.0:5:5:0.35 (chroma 0.35 untouched), hqdn3d 0.8:0.6:3.0:2.0 unchanged. Measured on compressed anime-style 1920x1080 render (line art, flat skin/sky fills, gradient, sensor-noise shimmer, h264 crf23): baseline src lapvar=332; old native 0.75/0.85=1790 (edge|lap|=118.6, flat-noise=0.15); cas0.85/luma0.95=2299; FINAL cas0.9/luma1.0=2846 (edge=147.2, flat-noise=0.17 ~ baseline 0.14) — +59% sharper than shipped values, no disproportionate ringing (edge metric scales linearly with amount), no flat-fill noise amplification. TRIED+REJECTED: cas0.95/luma1.1 (lapvar 4278 but flat-noise 0.38, doubled = visible grain crawl in sky/skin); cas0.9/luma0.95 (2757, marginally softer, no benefit vs 1.0); smartblur difference-blend clarity stage via blend=grainextract:all_opacity=0.25 (lapvar DROPPED to 1348 and flat-noise doubled to 0.39 — subtractive at fine scales, fights the sharpeners; left out). eq/color untouched (LUT owns grade). Full real-module enhance_one() render incl. haldclut LUT passed with validate_enhanced() mobile-safe contract OK (1920x1080, yuv420p, CFR 30, High, no B-frames). Regression tests 5/5 pass. Confidence: high on artifact-safety (flat-noise at baseline), moderate on perceptual pop magnitude (synthetic stand-in for real anime; values bracketed conservatively at the strongest artifact-free point).
